name: Marquee
description: Full-width hero banner with a large heading, body text, CTAs, and optional background image or video. Use for top-of-page hero sections. Don't use for: compact callouts (aside), text-only sections (text), multi-column grids (columns).
visualSignals: Large heading (h1 or display size), 1–2 CTA buttons, optional background fill or image, optional small icon/logo above the heading

rows.note: variants in parentheses after block name; dark is default — add 'light' for light-background designs

cols.contains: h1 heading + p body + strong>a primary CTA + em>a secondary CTA

domInput.notes: The block auto-detects which column contains the heading. dark is the default class — specify 'light' variant for light-background designs.
